picks.editorial_note: A Pritzker Prize for AI-enabled antibiotic discovery marks one of the field's clearest wins against a global health threat — AI-designed compounds moving from lab concept to award-winning, real-world drug candidates.
picks.title: Regina Barzilay and Jim Collins win Pritzker Prize for AI and Science Research Excellence for work in AI-enabled antibiotic discovery

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge's AI-guided vaccine design achieved complete protection against diverse bird flu variants in animal trials, a rare case of AI directly producing a validated biomedical result with pandemic-preparedness stakes.
picks.title: Scientists are using AI to develop superior vaccines against viruses threatening global health

picks.editorial_note: Anthropic's pledge of up to 5% of its equity (potentially $100 billion) to the public is a landmark moment in how AI wealth gets distributed, raising major questions about governance and public benefit that will shape policy debate.
picks.title: Billions in SpaceX, Anthropic Stock Pledged to the Public. Who Benefits? - Georgetown University

picks.editorial_note: A $24.5 million NSF award to build secure national AI research infrastructure signals serious federal investment in the cyber-backbone that will underpin future AI-driven science.
picks.title: Nebraska to lead cybersecurity for national AI research project

picks.editorial_note: HKUST and HSBC's strategic framework agreement extends a near three-decade relationship into a dedicated AI institute, showing how major financial institutions are formalizing long-term academic AI partnerships.
picks.title: HKUST and HSBC Forge Strategic Partnership to Advance AI, Emerging Technologies and Financial Innovation
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: Up to €20 million in German federal funding for TUM's autonomous public transportation testbed represents a significant government bet on AI-driven mobility infrastructure.
picks.title: Autonomous Public Transportation: TUM Opens New DZM Location in Munich

picks.editorial_note: An NIH-funded, multi-institutional effort combining satellite imaging, health data, and AI to probe environmental drivers of Alzheimer's and dementia tackles a major public health question at unusual scale.
picks.title: Case Western Reserve-led team to study how the environment contributes to Alzheimer’s and dementia | CWRU Newsroom | Case Western Reserve University

picks.editorial_note: The DOE's release of 'Genesis Agent Skills,' built in part by Fermilab, standardizes agentic AI tooling across the national lab system — a policy-driven infrastructure move with broad downstream research impact.
picks.title: ‘Genesis Agent Skills’ release to support innovation across the Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's MoU with robotics maker Unitree, aimed at a joint embodied-AI laboratory, links leading academic robotics research directly to a commercial hardware platform.
picks.title: HKUST and Unitree Sign MoU to Advance Embodied AI and Robotics Collaboration
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: Tel Aviv and Stanford researchers showing AI models can learn general predictive skills from purely self-generated synthetic data challenges assumptions about the need for real-world training data.
picks.title: AI Learns to Predict the World Without Ever Seeing It
